name: Dry Times
summary: Barkeep Daniels needs drink for Lakeshire's inn while Blackrock orcs keep the town under siege. The roads are unsafe, and the usual supplies have stopped coming.

sections.title: A Town Under Siege
sections.body: Blackrock orcs descend from Stonewatch Keep, pressing Lakeshire hard. With supply lines cut and roads unsafe, the inn is running low on drink. Barkeep Daniels turns to travelers who can cross the blocked roads and bring supplies back for frightened villagers and the town guards.

sections.title: A Grand Tour of the Kingdom
sections.body: Daniels needs drink from across Stormwind's lands. You can find Merlot in the capital, Sweet Rum at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, Moonshine in Darkshire in Duskwood, and Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the hills of Westfall.

faq.q: Why is Lakeshire running out of alcohol?
faq.answer: Blackrock orcs have disrupted Redridge's trade and stopped the supply caravans. Daniels's usual shipments are overdue, and his inn is running dry while Lakeshire faces the strain of war.

faq.q: Where do I find all the drinks Barkeep Daniels needs?
aliases: where to buy merlot moonshine rum
where to get drinks for daniels
faq.answer: You can find Merlot in Stormwind City, Sweet Rum in Goldshire in Elwynn Forest, Moonshine in Darkshire in Duskwood, and Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the hills of Westfall.
Grimbooze Thunderbrew is a dwarven brewer in the hills of Westfall. Daniels wants his lager, and you need to secure a fresh keg for Grimbooze first.
Barkeep Daniels runs the inn in Lakeshire. With Blackrock orcs threatening the town, he hires travelers to bring supplies along the dangerous roads.

faq.q: Why does Daniels need drinks from so many different regions?
faq.answer: Daniels serves refugees, local militiamen, and passing adventurers. He needs dwarven lager, fine wine from the capital, and spirits from Duskwood and Elwynn.

faq.q: What reward does Barkeep Daniels give for making the run?
faq.answer: Daniels reimburses your travel expenses with coins and gives you a hand-crafted cloak sewn by his wife for braving the contested roads.

angles.text: As an Alliance courier, you see how unsafe roads in Redridge disrupt daily life. You help reconnect trade between Stormwind, Elwynn, Westfall, Duskwood, and Redridge.
As a dwarf, you know human taverns depend on dwarven brewing, even during an orc invasion. Couriers travel to Westfall for Grimbooze Thunderbrew's renowned lager.
